levels.surface: محمد بن عثمان بن عبد الله بن موهب

notes: «وأبوه، عثمان أنهما سمعا» is one link: the father is named, so the surface is the name alone; the father's name is occurrence 2 because «عثمان» also stands inside «محمد بن عثمان»
«بمثل هذا الحديث» refers to the saying, not to the chain, so it is not a back reference; the Prophet is the end
